{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
data_clean = data[~(data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Confirm no refunded orders have converted = 1 (should be 0)
refunded_converted = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']['converted'].sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders with converted = 1: {refunded_converted}")

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment using data_clean (after dropping QA orders)
conversion_by_segment = data_clean.groupby('customer_segment', observed=True)['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(conversion_by_segment)

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()
print(f"\nHighest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}")"}
